headline: President Clinton made a further change to Executive Order 12864, a 1993 order that set up an advisory council on the national information infrastructure.
what_it_does: This order changes an earlier executive order, number 12864. That 1993 order created a council of outside advisers to counsel the government on building the nation's communications and computer networks, often called the 'information superhighway.' The title does not say what the change is, and no summary was provided, so the exact details are unclear.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the federal advisory council created by Executive Order 12864
who_it_affects.how: The amendment likely changes some rule about how the council is set up or runs, but the specific change is not stated in the available information.

when_it_takes_effect: Likely upon signing on September 14, 1995, though the source does not say.
